title: The cell’s selective boundary
hook: Inspect the cell and find the structure behind its function.

knows: Atoms or cells can be represented with simplified models.
doesNotKnow: The plasma membrane surrounds the cell and selectively regulates transport between the cell and its surroundings. It is a phospholipid bilayer containing proteins.

misconception: A familiar diagram automatically reveals the structure or function.
objective: The plasma membrane surrounds the cell and selectively regulates transport between the cell and its surroundings. It is a phospholipid bilayer containing proteins.
